sources.supports: The DNS provider handles console DNS requests, may block PSN, and the documented normal-PSN route restores automatic DNS.

Search-indexed primary project documentation describes update-host blocking for the two supplied resolvers; direct repository retrieval returned404 during review, so no guarantee of current resolver behavior is claimed.
Console network settings and advanced DNS configuration.
PlayStation can suspend accounts or consoles; account and console restrictions are distinct.
Current official terms prohibit unauthorized hardware/software and describe actions against accounts and systems.

editorialDecision: Describe intended update-server blocking and possible PSN restrictions, rather than promising all Sony domains are blocked or that DNS prevents bans. Restoring normal DNS may permit update connections; it does not guarantee safe online jailbreak use.
